description: Dataset of cartpole stabilization trajectories generated using LQR controller with PyBullet physics simulation.

theta_dot.description: Pole angular velocity (initial sampling range only)

success.name: Goal State Reached
success.condition: State converges to [0, 0, 0, 0] within tolerance for specified duration
success.description: Trajectory successfully stabilizes the cartpole at the origin

failure.name: State Out of Bounds
failure.condition: Any state variable exceeds its termination threshold

x.reason: Cart position exceeds safe operating range

x_dot.reason: Cart velocity becomes too high (control failed to stabilize)

theta.reason: No angular limit (pole can fully rotate)

theta_dot.reason: Pole angular velocity becomes too high

failure.description: Trajectory fails when controller cannot stabilize the system

timeout.name: Maximum Episode Length Exceeded
timeout.condition: Trajectory reaches max_steps (1000 steps) without success or failure
timeout.description: Episode forcibly terminated after reaching maximum allowed duration

termination_thresholds.description: Trajectories terminate when any state's absolute value exceeds these bounds

dynamics_constraints.description: NO velocity clipping during simulation - velocities can exceed initial bounds but will be terminated when they exceed them

control_parameters.description: Maximum control force applied to cart, clipped to [-2000, +2000] N

simulation_parameters.description: Control at 100 Hz (dt=0.01s), physics simulation at 5000 Hz, states saved every 0.01s

controller.description: Linear Quadratic Regulator for stabilization to origin

successful_trajectories.description: Trajectories that reached the goal state

timeout_trajectories.description: Trajectories that reached max_steps without terminating

achieved_bounds.description: Actual min/max values achieved across all trajectories

x.note: Exceeds bounds slightly (~0.047m) due to control timestep (dt=0.01s) before termination check

x_dot.note: EXCEEDS initial bounds (�5.0) because velocity clipping is disabled - natural dynamics

theta_dot.note: EXCEEDS initial bounds (�5.0) because velocity clipping is disabled - natural dynamics

data_format.file_naming: sequence_{i}.txt where i is the trajectory index (0 to 116241)
notes: Each line represents one state at a control timestep (100 Hz = 0.01s intervals)
First line is the initial state
Last line is either goal state or out-of-bounds state that triggered termination
Values are separated by commas with no spaces
